newsitem.title: USA: RJR Nabisco says 448 suits pending vs unit.
newsitem.headline: RJR Nabisco says 448 suits pending vs unit.

text.p: RJR Nabisco Holdings Corp said Friday there were 448 active tobacco-related cases pending as of August 7 against its unit R.J. Reynold Tobbaco Co or its affiliates.
The figure compares with 203 cases pending in July 1996 and 68 in July 1995, RJR Nabisco said in a 10-Q filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The cases include claims that lung cancer and other diseases as well as addiction have resulted from the use of or exposure to the unit's tobacco products, it said.
During the second quarter of 1997, 124 new suits were filed or served against the unit or its affiliates, compared with 44 in the second quarter of 1996, it said.
Of the number filed in the second quarter of 1997, 57 suits were dismissed or resolved in favor of the unit or affiliates without trial, it said.
Since the close of the second quarter, an additional 117 suits have been filed or served and 14 dismissed, it said.

Of the cases pending as of August 7, it said 443 are in the U.S., one in Canada, three in Puerto Rico and one in Guam. The U.S. cases are filed in 44 states, of which 179, the biggest number, are in Florida, it said.
